# Snake Animation Attribution

The local-only `snake.mjs` bundles the SVG renderer, path solver, and types from Platane/snk:
https://github.com/Platane/snk

Source commit: a041d6c27ba561a39f5be9c26a784812765e434b.
No license file was found at this commit. Do not describe it as MIT or redistribute the local bundle as licensed code. It belongs to an earlier local draft; the current README, refresh script, workflow and publishing package do not use or include the snake bundle.

Skill icon assets come from tandpfun/skill-icons (MIT), source commit 7f7e691e71aec64e8354bf697835e009d1ad80f8:
https://github.com/tandpfun/skill-icons
See LICENSE-skill-icons for the original license.

The current README uses compact original brand SVGs from gilbarbara/logos, retrieved through cdn.svgporn.com:
https://github.com/gilbarbara/logos
Python, TypeScript, React, SQLite, Git and GitHub logos remain the property of their respective owners.
GitHub's monochrome logo has a local light/dark color adaptation; SQLite is cropped to its database/feather mark without the wordmark. Earlier skill-icons assets are retained but no longer displayed.

Language and activity plots use D3 7.9.0 (ISC), installed as a dependency.
Profile data is a public GitHub snapshot, not a measure of skill proficiency.
